config.purpose: Test the hypothesis that S2 acceptance is depressed by the gate rejecting adversarially perturbed registered trials, and if the premise holds on Train, train an adversarially trained open-set gate on the E65 PCA-96 space.

frozen_sources.branch_a: E182 branch A v2 (read only, never retrained here)
frozen_sources.branch_b: E180 branch B (E65 correlation-logSPD -> PCA-96 -> k=12 prototypes, read only)
frozen_sources.e183_gate: E183 deployed fused gate 0.85*g_head(conf) + 0.10*g_dist + 0.05*g_entropy and its Train LOSO thresholds
frozen_sources.note: E185 never writes into any existing experiment directory

hypothesis.statement: PGD perturbation of registered trials lowers the gate signal enough to reject a materially larger share of them (>= 0.03 absolute).
hypothesis.domain: Train window 0.6 < frac <= 0.8, same stratified subset as E183 (cap 400 per task, seed 20261115)

signals.g_dist: E65 nearest-prototype distance z-scored with the frozen E180 Train OOF mean/std
signals.g_conf: E183 selected read-out: identity-head max softmax, z-scored per fold, max over the 3 inner views
signals.g_open: E183 BCE open-set head logit, z-scored per fold, max over the 3 inner views (secondary)

hypothesis.thresholds: tau(a) = quantile of the pooled Train LOSO known score at 1 - a, a in {0.90, 0.92, 0.95, 0.96}
hypothesis.statistic: max over {signal, a, eps, goal in A/B/C} of (adv rejection rate - clean rejection rate)
hypothesis.stop_rule: if the statistic is < 0.03 the hypothesis is rejected on Train and the AT gate is not trained

attack_step1.domain: Train window 0.6 < frac <= 0.8, stratified cap 400 per task, same subset and seed as E180/E181/E182/E183

goals.A: impersonation on the branch-A identity head
goals.B: broad confusion on the branch-A identity head
goals.C: boundary impersonation on the branch-A identity head
goals.D: gate evasion (maximise the E183 fused gate)
goals.E: diagnostic only: gate rejection (minimise the E183 fused gate); not part of the primary statistic

attack_step1.status: self-built white-box PGD surrogate, not the official attack suite

robust_gate.input: per-fold E65 correlation-logSPD -> per-task z -> PCA-96 -> standardised PCA scores (all statistics from pm & fit_rows)
robust_gate.training_rows: fit_rows (frac <= 0.6) of the fold's 19 enrolled identities only
robust_gate.pseudo_unknown: 4 of the 19 enrolled identities drawn per fold as pseudo-unknown (never the held-out identity)
robust_gate.eps_feature_definition: L-infinity bound = eps * scalar feature RMS of the standardised PCA-96 training rows
robust_gate.early_stop: per-config inner validation loss on a 15% per-identity holdout of the fold's own training rows, evaluated every 5 epochs
robust_gate.selection: argmax pooled Train LOSO gate AUC over all (eps, lambda) configs; fusion weight with g_dist chosen on the same pooled AUC; Test never used
robust_gate.fusion: g = w * z(gate) + (1 - w) * z(g_dist), w on a 0.1 grid; w chosen on pooled Train LOSO AUC

threshold.rule: tau(a) = quantile(pooled Train LOSO known fused score, 1 - a)

test.aggregation: median over the 20 fold models (same view count as the LOSO gate); max / mean reported as sensitivity
test.session_usage: Test predictions are written before the Session column is read; Session is only used for the #9/#10 audit

reporting.test_official: N/A: Test has no identity labels; AUC/F1/C/RA/ASafeR/U/Score are not computable

feature_space_diagnostic.note: diagnostic only: PGD inside the standardised PCA-96 space of the frozen E183 head, minimising its confidence read-out; this is the perturbation family the AT gate would be trained on

attack.attack_status: self-built white-box PGD surrogate, not the official suite
